job.question: Which retirement system's investment consultant RFP requires firms to certify that they currently provide investment consulting services to clients whose combined assets total at least $50 billion?
job.expected_facts: Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois (TRS Illinois), in its FY23 investment consultant RFP (Appendix B, Statement of Minimum Qualifications).
job.acceptance: TRS Illinois / Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois is sufficient; FY23 and appendix identifier are optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund sample RFP, not a Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois RFP. Its stated qualification concerns one client with at least $10 billion in assets; it does not require certification of current consulting clients with combined assets of at least $50 billion.
quotes: The Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund (IMRF) is requesting proposals from investment consulting firms

Demonstrated experience in providing discretionary or non-discretionary investment advisory services to large public pension plan clients, at least one of which must have total plan assets of $10 billion.
